inventory_evidence_sql.sql: SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolcreatedb,rolcreaterole,rolreplication,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('retail_ingest','retail_transform') ORDER BY rolname
SELECT version_id,parent_id,base_run_id,status,depth,acknowledged_publication_id FROM ingestion_meta.incremental_versions ORDER BY depth
SELECT viewname FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname='raw' AND viewname LIKE 'current_%'

SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,p.prosecdef,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE (n.nspname='raw' AND p.proname LIKE 'sales_state_%') OR (n.nspname='ingestion_meta' AND p.proname IN ('assert_sales_version','guard_incremental_append','guard_incremental_ledger')) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND ((n.nspname='raw' AND c.relname LIKE 'delta_%') OR(n.nspname='ingestion_meta' AND c.relname LIKE 'incremental_%')) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='r' AND ((n.nspname='raw' AND c.relname LIKE 'delta_%') OR (n.nspname='ingestion_meta' AND c.relname LIKE 'incremental_%') OR n.nspname='dw_staging') ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT dq_status,count(*) FROM dq.record_status GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dq.validation_violations),(SELECT count(*) FROM dq.quarantine_records)

limitations: Full source scans; not CDC or a watermark-filtered source extraction.
Source consistency remains UNVERIFIED; live absence is blocked, not applied as DELETE.
Mutation/recovery and model propagation proven in isolated PostgreSQL fixtures; no live WWI DML.
Acknowledged source checkpoint remains NULL, bound to a future approved publication; candidate boundary is not publication ACK.
Development analytical models are rebuilt in place under runner lock; no atomic Certified consumer publication.
Maximum ancestor depth32; reviewed compaction is not implemented. No sealed chunk replay/network chaos test.
Peak Python RSS not measured; merge is streaming with bounded batches, but individual LOB size affects memory.
Materialized incremental staging adds storage to avoid repeated opaque function scans; Raw payloads are not recopied.
Prior dbt performance stops and unversioned fidelity-oracle failures are retained, not counted as PASS.
Fixtures from failed/debug runs are retained in dedicated prefixed test objects; no automatic cleanup.
